text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 宠物诊所.
Environment: Empty veterinary clinic reception with grey-green counter, shelves, waiting seats and connected consultation space.
Visual medium: otome 2d5d 3d; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic overhead CONCEPT PLAN. Depict footprint, connected zones, wall thickness, doors, windows, stairs, furniture footprints and circulation. For outdoors use a site plan of paths, terrain, bridges and water instead of domestic rooms. North is only design orientation. Compact labels; no invented metric dimensions. Flat diagram on white background.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Convert the supplied spatial reconstruction into a TRUE 2D ORTHOGRAPHIC FLOOR/SITE PLAN for 宠物诊所. Camera exactly straight down, zero tilt. Flat BLACK technical drafting lines on WHITE page, restrained pale grey fill. Absolutely NO 3D rendering, NO visible wall faces, NO visible fronts of doors or cabinets, NO perspective, NO texture/photo. Draw only horizontal footprints: thick cut walls, thin furniture/object outlines, doors with standard swing arcs, steps as parallel horizontal tread lines, tree canopy as simple circle. Match every feature and its position from the reference, same connected footprint. Do not add rooms. Clear short labels and north arrow. Title CONCEPT PLAN. No scale bars, no numbers for dimensions, no people. This must look like an architectural CAD floor plan, NOT a raised birdseye photograph. Fill landscape image with the clean legible plan.
